macros.name: AND
macros.doc: This macro can be used for the logical conjunction.

macros.name: Exists
macros.doc: The \Forall and the \Exists macros take one argument. They typeset the respective quantifier followed by the argument (i.e. the variable) and finally a small space.

macros.name: Forall
macros.doc: The \Forall and the \Exists macros take one argument. They typeset the respective quantifier followed by the argument (i.e. the variable) and finally a small space.

macros.name: IF
macros.doc: This macro can be used for the logical implication written in reverse order.

macros.name: IFF
macros.doc: This macro can be used for the logical equivalence.

macros.name: is
macros.doc: This macro is for typesetting unifiers.

macros.name: OR
macros.doc: This macro can be used for the logical disjunction.

macros.name: XOR
macros.doc: This macro can be used for the exclusive disjunction.
